title: Merchandise Purchases Loss Prevention Standard — Returns Without a Receipt
content:
**Standard.** Across all of a customer's Merchandise Purchases returns, no more than the class's limit of returns without a receipt is accepted in a rolling 12 months. The count covers the customer's return requests made without a receipt that were received or refunded, over the 12 calendar months ending on the return date, each request counted by the date it was created.

A purchase made with a Marlowe & Finch card, or with the customer's Finch Circle number linked, within the class's purchase lookup period is found from those records and is returned as an order-record return, not as a no-receipt return.

A no-receipt return:
- is possible only for a merchandise class that accepts returns without a receipt;
- requires the customer's government photo ID to be recorded;
- is refunded as a merchandise credit card at the lowest selling price of that item in the class's lookback period before the return date, and never to a card or in cash.

## Condition — judgement — result

| Condition on the records | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| The purchase is found through the customer's Marlowe & Finch card or linked Finch Circle number within the lookup period | It is an order-record return | The no-receipt terms do not govern it |
| Neither receipt nor order record exists, and the class accepts no-receipt returns | It is a no-receipt return | ID recorded; refund as a merchandise credit card at the lowest selling price in the lookback |
| Neither receipt nor order record exists, and the class does not accept no-receipt returns | No no-receipt return is possible | — |

## Hypothetical counting cases

Suppose a class limit of 3 (the figure used in the class schedule) and a return date of 10 June:
- received or refunded no-receipt returns created on 2 July, 15 November and 3 March of the preceding twelve months — three already counted, so a fourth is not accepted;
- the same history except that the earliest request was created on 9 June of the previous year, outside the 12 calendar months ending on 10 June — two counted, so this return is accepted.
